title: Meter Tech: Frozen AMI Meter — Route 41

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Control, this is Meter Tech Harris on Route 41. The meter at 123 Oak Street just went into a 48-hour freeze. It's showing 0.000 GPM and won't reset. I can't access it remotely. Should I just leave it?
Copy, Harris. Confirm the meter ID and status. We’re tracking a system-wide anomaly — you’re not alone on this route. Hold position. We’ll validate the AMI feed and send a follow-up.

fields.voiceStyle: Young male, neutral tone, slight static in background

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The AMI system is under attack, and this is a false alert masked as a hardware failure.
